in_marathi.name: Dheeravi
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dheeravi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Dheeravi is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘dheerah’, meaning fearless or brave. This name is often given to girls who are believed to possess the qualities of courage and strength. In Hindu mythology, Dheeravi is the name of a brave and beautiful demoness who was known for her strength and determination.
